name: Cluster Tokens
author: Tanner Osterkamp
description: Tokens served by the local open-source cluster (one model) in the bar, summed from the once-a-minute cluster-telemetry samples. No network calls and no keys.

barWidget.description: One chip (OSS) with tokens the cluster served today and a dot for engine up or down. Click to switch between today, 7 days, 30 days and all time.
